name: MLPerf v6.1 AMD 8xMI355X_2xEPYC_9575F llama2-70b-99.9 Interactive run_1 harness summary log
notes: THE KEY ARTIFACT FOR THE SCENARIO GOTCHA. Result is : VALID, Completed tokens per second 73191.51 - but the log's own header line reads 'Scenario : Server', not 'Scenario : Interactive'. The Interactive result is stored in a directory named Interactive and published in a summary.csv column named Interactive, while the harness log calls it Server and prints 'Performance constraints satisfied: Yes'. Nothing inside the log distinguishes it from a Server run; the ttft<=450ms / tpot<=40ms bounds are compiled into the harness, not recorded in the log. A reader auditing only the raw logs cannot tell an Interactive run from a Server run.
